name: Induced-draft fan

hierarchy.system: A-3000 compatible wet-acid vent treatment context

design.materialOfConstruction: Vinyl-ester-novolac FRP after cooling/wetting; PP/PVDF packing/demister; 316L or Alloy 601/602 CA on hot/dry/H₂ upstream branches
design.feedBasis: 333,000 Nm³/h if A-600 were air-swept at 1 wt % (REP-026 F-27/F-29) — DBM specifies an inert closed loop for A-600; A-600 has its own F-601 / SC-601 and is not an A-3000 load

reviewFindings: The original Draft - Not for Use sheet joins wet/dry and furnace gases. P01 is a proposed NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION redraw, not approval. HD-3100 accepts candidate compatible wet vents only. Thermal/reactive gas, carbon/oxidizer dust, peroxide breathing, dryer vacuum exhaust and emergency relief remain separate. A-900 furnace wording conflicts with cartridge filling; no source is inferred.

Original EX3003 operating bypass is deleted in the model/P01. Only a positively blinded stub remains, with no fan connection or operating stream. Loss of draft/liquor flow, high differential pressure or unqualified pH requires a reviewed response: inhibit new feed/heat, retain available residual-emission treatment, and do not blanket-close vessel vents. Fan stop is not vent isolation.

Model 5000 Nm3/h, 40 C, 3500 Pa drop, 2 m tower diameter and 12 m stack height are screening/layout inputs, not ratings or approved limits. KO separation is not a fine-mist guarantee or cooling duty. ME-3150 fiber-bed duty, removal efficiency, pressure budget, corrosion/materials and stack dispersion/emission acceptance remain unqualified.

Acidic KO condensate and alkaline high-salt blowdown have distinct normally isolated A-1000 returns. Neutralization does not remove dissolved salts before A-2000. Sealed liquid returns and dedicated dirty-side pressure balances require verification at minimum liquid level and maximum differential pressure. Fan/stack low drains remain separately blinded with no continuous drainage credit.

Makeup water uses a proposed physical air gap and buffer/pump; supply is blinded, overflow goes to an unqualified local catch tray. NaOH breathing stays independent. T-3180 is retained despite TK-3180 wording in the original notes. P01 uses AIT-3180 for pH while the model uses pHT-3180 for pH and AIT-3180 for conductivity: no instrument tag is selected. pH, flow, level, pressure and other trip limits remain null; no live control or SIS is validated.
